results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · Bluetooth off / band off / out of range → dashboard alert says so
results.why: Band disconnected — no buzz.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · band back in range → dashboard alert buzzes
results.why: App is foreground; the data handler + ANCS both reach the band → buzz.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · band off → text message says so
results.why: Shown on phone; band disconnected.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · band off → wake alarm falls back to the phone
results.why: Band disconnected at fire time — phone backup notification only.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · band button with the band off → not counted as an acknowledgement
results.why: Band disconnected — button press not received.

results.n: Pixel 8 · Bluetooth off / band off / out of range → dashboard alert says so
results.why: Band disconnected — no buzz.

results.n: Pixel 8 · band back in range → dashboard alert buzzes
results.why: App foreground; background handler buzzes the band.

results.n: Pixel 8 · band off → text message says so
results.why: Band disconnected — buzz queued and replayed on reconnect.

results.n: Pixel 8 · band off → wake alarm falls back to the phone
results.why: Band disconnected at fire time — phone backup notification only.

results.n: Pixel 8 · band button with the band off → not counted as an acknowledgement
results.why: Band disconnected — button press not received.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · notifications not reaching the band (ANCS off) → says so
results.why: ANCS not granted — band silent.

results.n: iPhone 15 Pro · ANCS back on → text buzzes
results.why: iOS forwards it over ANCS → band buzzes. Phrase filters don’t apply on iOS (iOS never gives the band the text) — that’s why the app hides them there.

results.n: Pixel 8 · exact-alarm permission off → app warns it may be late
results.why: Exact-alarm permission is off (Android 12+). The alarm may fire late or not at all in Doze. The app now prompts to fix this.
